newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cen bank 2-wk rev repo avg yield 15.7 pct. [CORRECTED 09:06 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Czech cen bank 2-wk rev repo avg yield 15.7 pct. [CORRECTED 09:06 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects period in headline from 1 week to 2 weeks)
The average yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) two-week reverse repo tender on Tuesday reached the maximum limit yield of 15.70 percent, the CNB said.
The central bank said it accepted all bids at that level. Minimum yield was 15.69 percent. The two-week Prague interbank offered rate was trading around 16.20 percent on Tuesday.
